scope: Short internal labels derived from typed object names inside each item's own shipped bundle. Derived names are preservation display labels, not historical storefront names. No original item name, description, price or store membership string tied to an item was found.
sources_without_item_names: resources.assets, globalgamemanagers.assets, sharedassets0.assets, level0: no item ID in any MonoBehaviour string; TextAssets are licensing/currency/typography only
StreamingAssets scene, pooler, nav and screenloader bundles: 24 MonoBehaviours in nexus, sorcererseyrie, thenebulian logic prefabs and pre hold 14 bare item IDs with no other string
IL2CPP string literals: item IDs appear only as resource paths and gathering reward debug text, never beside a display name
ShopData/ItemData names and descriptions are server-supplied (EntryData deserialization) and absent from the client
